label: Compatible-period activity
missingness_rule: NA when no compatible weeks
notes: Source-coded activity zero is retained when observed.

label: Compatible-period facility exposure
transformation: sum(cumulative_plugs) over the same compatible dates
missingness_rule: NA when no compatible weeks
notes: An exposure aggregate rather than a count of new facilities.

label: Compatible source-week count
transformation: count of source dates with compatible_week=True
missingness_rule: NA when compatibility cannot be established
notes: No compatible weeks are not recoded as zero.

label: Activity per compatible week
missingness_rule: NA when W<=0 or Q unavailable
notes: Used for descriptive and annual models.

label: Average facility exposure
missingness_rule: NA when W<=0 or E unavailable

label: Activity intensity
missingness_rule: NA when E<=0 or Q unavailable
notes: An index of activity per exposure; not engineering utilization.

label: Observed facility-addition measure
missingness_rule: NA excludes the facility-outcome model eligibility flag
notes: This field is separate from N=E/W.

label: Facility outcome observation status
allowed_values_or_range: observed_complete; observed_partial; observed_zero; observed; complete; partial
missingness_rule: NA or other labels exclude facility-outcome eligibility
notes: The accepted status set is an observation-qualification rule not a positive-outcome rule.

label: Facility observation eligibility
transformation: facility_additions_analysis is finite AND facility_outcome_status_v7 is in the accepted status set
missingness_rule: False or missing excludes facility-observation support
notes: Source-observation gate; distinct from positive Q/E/W and N=E/W.

label: Facility outcome eligibility
transformation: facility_additions_analysis is finite AND facility_outcome_status_v7 is in the accepted status set
missingness_rule: False when either condition fails
notes: This qualification is distinct from positive Q/E/W and distinct from N.

label: Activity outcome eligibility
missingness_rule: False or missing excludes activity-outcome use

label: Common outcome eligibility
missingness_rule: False or missing excludes common use

label: Prior-year information/supervision exposure
missingness_rule: Unknown source coverage remains NA

label: Prior-year operation/maintenance exposure
missingness_rule: Unknown source coverage remains NA

label: Compatible-date COVID stringency mean
missingness_rule: Missing or incomplete exposure excludes adjusted specification
notes: The adjusted estimator uses this value divided by 10.

label: Annual precipitation
missingness_rule: Incomplete calendar totals remain missing

label: Annual mean wind speed
missingness_rule: Insufficient daily coverage remains missing

missingness_rule: Insufficient daily coverage remains missing
